name: Rondo
source:
A collection of five stories based on Japanese old legends.
One day the hero gets a means to travel between five different worlds.
It is a world of fairy tales that the hero adored since he was a child.
His exciting journey begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
五个故事均取材自日本古老传说。

一天，主角获得了在五个不同世界之间旅行的方法。
那是一个他从小就憧憬的童话世界。

令人兴奋的旅程就此开始。

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndreview[/url]）
